title: NAPCO Expands MVP Access with New Identity Management, Video Integrations & Cybersecurity Features
summary: NAPCO Security Technologies has released the latest version of its MVP Access cloud-based access control platform, introducing five new enhancements that make it even easier for security dealers and integrators to deliver a more connected, secure, and efficient solution for commercial customers.
body_markdown:
For Immediate Release
333 Bayview Avenue
Amityville, NY 11701
1-800-645-9445
ContactJudith Jones


**Amityville, NY** — NAPCO Security Technologies has released the latest version of its MVP Access cloud-based access control platform, introducing five new enhancements that make it even easier for security dealers and integrators to deliver a more connected, secure, and efficient solution for commercial customers.


Designed for installations from a single door to enterprise systems with thousands of openings, MVP Access is NAPCO's scalable, unified cloud platform combining access control, video, badging, security integration, and wireless networked locking in one affordable monthly per-door cloud service. Systems are deployed in minutes using the MVP-EZ App and its exclusive Scan2Enroll™ feature, which enrolls controllers and locks simply by scanning a QR code. Customers can manage users, credentials, schedules, and security from the MVP-EZ App or a customizable web browser interface, ideal for security, facilities, and HR departments. Supporting NAPCO cloud-ready controllers, readers, multi-technology wireless locks, virtually every credential technology, mobile credentials, and Multi-Factor Authentication, MVP Access easily scales as organizations grow.


The latest release adds Single Sign-On (SSO) and automated user provisioning through Microsoft Entra ID, allowing organizations to authenticate users with existing corporate credentials while simplifying IT administration and streamlining employee onboarding and offboarding. New integrations with ExacqVision and Milestone XProtect VMS video platforms (in addition to Hanwha Wave and DW supported) further unify access control and video by enabling operators to view access events, live and recorded video, alarms, users, and remote door controls from a single interface for faster verification and response.


The release also introduces Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), supporting both Microsoft Authenticator and Google Authenticator to provide an additional layer of protection against unauthorized account access.


"Customers continue to look for tighter integration between physical security, video, and their IT infrastructure," said Rob Etmans, VP, NAPCO Fire, Access Control & Security Technologies. "These latest MVP Access enhancements make the platform even more valuable by simplifying user management, strengthening cybersecurity, and bringing more security information together in one place for faster, more informed decisions."


To help dealers get up and running quickly, NAPCO offers free MVP Access training through live online webinars and hands-on classes at security distributor locations nationwide – View the latest schedule at[www.napcosecurity.com/seminars](https://napcosecurity.com/seminars) , with new classes added regularly. ***About NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc.** NAPCO Security Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: NSSC) is one of the world's leading manufacturers of technologically advanced electronic security equipment including intrusion and fire alarm systems, access control and door locking systems. The Company consists of NAPCO plus three wholly-owned subsidiaries: Alarm Lock, Continental Access, and Marks USA. The products are installed by security professionals worldwide in commercial, industrial, institutional, residential and government applications. NAPCO products have earned a reputation for technical excellence, reliability and innovation, poising the Company for growth in the rapidly expanding electronic security market, a multi-billion dollar market.*
